verdict.rationale: Adyen's core integration is API-first and server-to-server (docs-1/docs-2), supports idempotency keys for safe automated retries (docs-4/docs-25), webhooks instead of polling for async status checks (docs-3/docs-17), and a documented test environment with test credentials for automated integration testing (docs-6/docs-18) — all consistent with headless/CI-driven automation. However, there is no explicit CI/CD pipeline guide, sandbox-automation SDK, or CLI/test-harness tooling documented for scripted pipelines. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration guide or test-automation SDK, sandboxed/ephemeral test account provisioning for pipelines, and independent evidence of teams running Adyen flows headlessly in CI.
